pr_title: Adds ExtendedDictionary That Implements Python Dict Methods
pr_body:
#### Description
`ExtendedDictionary` is an abstract implementation of `IExtendedDictionary` keyed by `Symbol` that implements Python `dict` methods. `Slice`, `DataDictionary`, `SecurityManager`, and `SecurityPortfolioManager` derives from it in order to behave like Python `dict`.

#### Related Issue
Closes #4243 

#### Motivation and Context
Make Lean more user-friendly for pythonistas.

#### Requires Documentation Change
N/A.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
New unit tests and regression test.

issue_context.title: Python Dictionary Support for C# Dictionary Derived Classed
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
C# classes in Lean that inherit from, and consequently behave like, `IDictionary` have Python `dict` methods. 

#### Actual Behavior
Not supported.

#### Potential Solution
Create a base dictionary class that implements the Python `dict` methods such as `get`, `pop`, items`, etc.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)

review_comments: This unit test is failing, `values()` is returning a `PyList` which it can't convert into a `List<BaseData>();`?

Actually, no. It is failing because we got:
```csharp
protected override IEnumerable<dynamic> GetValues
    => GetKeyValuePairEnumerable().Select(data => (dynamic)data);
```
instead of
```csharp
protected override IEnumerable<dynamic> GetValues
    => GetKeyValuePairEnumerable().Select(data => (dynamic)data.Value);
```
Seems we are missing another unit test which does test that update works? Could create a `private class SliceTest : Slice` which override Readonly to false
